decisions.reason: The formwork profile system is a multi-model product line with its own web page, close to the firm's core formwork offer, so it carries visible investment and public commitment that management would not write off.
The shuttering magnet block line has several models and sits at the heart of the firm's magnetic formwork range, so its sunk development costs and fit with the announced direction favour keeping it.
This magnetic formwork component was presented on its own page in both years, a visible commitment, and it complements the core offer, so dropping it would mean admitting an earlier misjudgement.

Only mentioned on the website and representing little investment, this component is the easiest to drop, but it still fits the established magnetic formwork range and nothing suggests its results have failed beyond temporary causes.
